text:
rachel: Running into a weird onboarding failure in the sample app when users flip on JSON-mode + tool calling. Full repro below.

tim: Can you paste the minimal repro?

rachel: Steps: 1) npx redwood-quickstart 2) register a simple tool that returns JSON string 3) make a chat.call with json_mode: true and schema validator. The SDK helper sometimes returns the payload wrapped in single backticks and also as an escaped string: `\"{\"cmd\":\"open\"}\"`. Validator throws.

kai: We saw something similar in a customer report. Is this the new "safeWrap" change?

rachel: I think so. The helper attempts to avoid markdown breakage by wrapping plain strings. It doesn't check json_mode. So when the model returns structured output, the helper mangles it.

nina: Also seeing intermittent auth refresh logs around same time in local dev:
```
AuthCache: refresh_in_progress=true
RequestQueue: queued=12
AuthManager: got 401 for request id=7 -> triggering global retry
```
A couple of those retries spiked and produced RetryError: auth refresh failed. Might be related to queued callbacks using stale tokens.

tim: Two workstreams then: 1) helper should not wrap when request.flag_json_mode === true OR response.meta?.format === 'structured' 2) harden the AuthManager refresh path to avoid duplicate concurrent refreshes (debounce) and ensure queued requests retry with new token only once.

kai: Proposed quick patch for helper: detect a top-level JSON-like start (trimmed text startsWith '{' or '[') and skip quoting. Add a parseStrictJSON helper that returns {ok:false, error, raw}. Tests should cover backtick-wrapped, escaped-string, and plain JSON.

rachel: I can prototype the parseStrictJSON util and add unit tests to devex-sdk. I'll include an option to surface the original raw response so debugging is easier.

nina: I'll open an infra ticket to add telemetry for failed schema parses (capture model, route, sdk_version, sample of raw text). That will help triage customer repros.

tim: Can we add a temporary ENV toggle for customers via sample-app? Something like REDWOOD_JSON_SAFE_WRAP=false to opt out until we ship fix.

rachel: Adding that to the quickstart README now.

infra-bot: ticket-5568 created: "AuthManager: debounce token refresh and avoid double retries" assigned to infra.

kai: I'll draft a small PR for the helper change (skip wrap when json_mode true OR content looks like JSON). Will add unit + integration test against sample-app.

tim: Great. After PR lands: 1) release patch to devex-sdk, 2) bump sample-app template, 3) publish note in #devex and update quickstart.

rachel: Thanks. Will follow up with the test failures and link to CI. Also tagging eng-ml on semantics of tool outputs so we don't suppress needed markdown in other flows.

kai: ping me when CI green, I'll roll the patch into the next minor release.
